provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10 through rest.uniprot.org/help/{license,programmatic_access,api,api_queries} (the www.uniprot.org pages are a JavaScript app): CC BY 4.0 on all copyrightable parts of the databases, cite per the "How to cite us" page; some data may be covered by patents or other rights. No request rate is published for the REST API; only the stream endpoint (not used by the source) limits parallel requests, without a figure, and answers 429. No RateLimit header seen on a live call. UniProt is also an EMBL-EBI service, under its terms of use (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/about/terms-of-use). No API contact address found on the pages read.
